sonnet.problem: The card says Zadok and Nathan are the ones to "anoint him there, then blow the ram's horn and declare" 'Long live King Solomon!' In 1 Kings 1:34, only Zadok and Nathan are told to anoint. The next sentence switches to "You are to blow the ram's horn and declare," and "You" is David speaking to all three men (Zadok, Nathan and Benaiah). The card narrows who blows the horn and declares, which the text does not do.
sonnet.rule: Leave open what the text leaves open. Who is being spoken to, why, or how two things connect.
